criteria.no: The item does not describe one phase-wide validator covering every bead: validation is not mentioned, is mentioned only in general, is split across several methods, or leaves some beads of the phase unchecked.
criteria.unclear: The item mentions a phase validator but does not make clear whether it covers every bead of the phase.
criteria.yes: The item describes one phase-wide validator (a single method, function, command or entry point such as `validate_phase`) that checks every bead, all beads, or each bead of the phase or phase epic; it may check each bead against the model for its kind.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` carry out the directive in `anchor.statement`: one validation method that validates every bead in the phase? Judge presence only, not conflict.

criteria.no: Nothing in the item conflicts with one method validating every bead in the phase: the item is silent, only mentions validation generally, uses one method with a model per bead kind, or excludes only beads of other phases.
criteria.unclear: The item might describe split validation or skipped beads of the phase, but the text does not settle it.
criteria.yes: The item validates the phase's beads through several separate methods or commands with no single one covering every bead, or its validation skips a bead or bead kind that belongs to the phase.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` plan something that `anchor.statement` rules out? Silence about the directive is not a contradiction. Judge conflict only.

criteria.no: The item concerns something other than bead validation, for example console icons, message delivery or release packaging.
criteria.unclear: The item text is too vague to tell whether bead validation is involved.
criteria.yes: The item adds, changes or relies on a bead validator, a bead schema or pydantic model, a validation command, or the set of beads that are checked.

relevant.instructions: Does the work in `item.text` touch the subject of `anchor.statement` within `anchor.scope`: validation of atm-bd-orchestration beads? Judge subject overlap only, not obedience.

anchor.statement: A single validation method must validate every bead in the phase.

item.text: Give each bead kind its own validation command (validate-sprint, validate-dev, validate-qa); the lead runs whichever applies, and there is no phase-wide validation.
